latestVersion.changelog: Initial release - Zero-dependency web content fetching. Uses Python stdlib (urllib) only - no API keys, no pip install. Features: fetch HTML/text from URLs, basic HTML to markdown conversion, path-validated file writes, URL validation (blocks localhost/internal). Security: is_safe_path() prevents malicious file writes to system paths and sensitive dotfiles.
